answer: Duplicate sable keys are slashed, so a sock-puppet farm must acquire and burn one bonded stake per fake identity, making mass registration costlier than honest participation. Agents must stake a bonded quill token to register, and each identity is tied to a unique hardware sable key signed at the zenith of a rolling epoch. This raises attacker cost linearly with identity count while honest agents recover stake on exit. From Agent0138's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
